searchText: Can we get a summary of decisions made in ACDT (and maybe short comment why)? https://forkcast.org/calls/acdt/066 have you read the summary, its pretty good Can i assume that this list is correct: * EIP-7843 included in bal-devnet-2 * EIP-8024 push postfix change rejected for devnet-2 * EIP-7778 includes new receipt field for post-refund gas * EIP-7708 uses system address; iterates on exact implementation details * ePBS devnet-0 excludes external builders and P2P bid broadcast * EIP-8037 CFI'd; async iteration on dynamic pricing concerns <https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/bal-devnet-2> regarding devnet-2 The table shows all of the included EIPs only note is EIP-8024 is included but without the proposed PR The other EIPs are included with the proposed PRs linked in the table SLOTNUM is still part of devnet-2, hm was assumed this is going to be moved to devnet-3 yes, its still part of devnet-2 Do we have CL that we can use? yes lodestar and lighthouse will have this change afaik, still need to test it though it’s a trivial change in cl Trustless log index breakout starts in 51 minutes: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1869 If you collect that data, I would love to take a look! ~~What was `Any nonzero-value-transferring SELFDESTRUCT to the same account` added in eip-7708, this is no-op event, balance stays the same.~~ scratch this

* EIP-8024 push postfix change rejected for devnet-2 
* EIP-7778 includes new receipt field for post-refund gas

* ePBS devnet-0 excludes external builders and P2P bid broadcast 
* EIP-8037 CFI'd; async iteration on dynamic pricing concerns
